assets.prompt: Create the original Kha'Rha biological hunting mount for the fan game La Longue Chasse, as a reusable 2D side-scrolling game asset. This is an ORIGINAL game creature, not an established Predator film animal, not an existing artist's design. Two complete strictly SIDE PROFILE drawings stacked vertically, upper facing RIGHT and lower facing LEFT as separately drawn opposite-side anatomy. Both exactly same body proportions and scale, all feet and tail visible with generous blank margins. Huge powerful quadruped blending feline musculature with reptilian charcoal-olive pebbled skin, partial natural dark bronze-brown segmented carapace over shoulders and upper spine, massive low broad predatory jaw, small amber eyes, thick muscular neck, powerful haunches, long balancing tapered tail. Exactly FOUR legs, each with a coherent paw and FOUR clear hooked claws; offset far legs enough to count all four. No humanoid hands, no mandibles borrowed from the rider, no horns, wings or duplicate limbs. Back has a broad low clear saddle-bearing area between shoulders and hips; no tall spikes there. Neutral alert standing pose, jaw closed, calm capable hunting partner. NO saddle, rider, tack, harness, straps, weapons, trophies or shadow because those are separate modules. Camera horizontal orthographic true profile, not top-down or isometric. Detailed hand-painted sci-fi game art with restrained highlights and crisp silhouette. True transparent alpha background, absolutely no painted checkerboard, labels, text, symbols, frame or scenery.
notes: Original design from the recovered Kha’Rha brief: muscular feline-reptilian quadruped, partial carapace and enormous jaw. Not claimed as franchise canon.
The saddle, rider, tack, trophies and shadow must remain independent modules.
Superseded identity: haze or overlapping extraction rectangles; use identity-r3.
